_comment: A reason is matched against these in order; the first bucket with a keyword
appearing anywhere in the normalised text wins. Unmatched reasons land in
'other', and the report says so -- a large 'other' share means this file is
incomplete, not that the reasons were unclear.
Keywords are matched after normalisation: lowercased, accents folded
(ue/ae/oe and umlauts both work), punctuation stripped. Add German and
English spellings for the same concept.
Edit this file rather than the code when a client's agent uses different
wording -- that is the whole point of it being config.
